operations.description: Deletes the meeting identified by the meetingId.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME]  [PATH] meetings [PARAMS] authorization id meeting [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Deletes the individual organizer specified by the email address. This API call is only available to users with the admin role.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME]  [PATH] organizers [PARAMS] authorization email [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Deletes the individual organizer specified by the organizer key. This API call is only available to users with the admin role.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME]  [PATH] organizers [PARAMS] authorization key organizer [SCHEMA]

operations.description: List all groups for an account. This API call is only available to users with the admin role.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] groups [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] group

operations.description: Returns all attendees for all meetings within specified date range held by organizers within the specified group. This API call is only available to users with the admin role. This API call can be used only for groups with maximum 50 organizers.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] groups attendees [PARAMS] authorization date end group key start [SCHEMA] attendee by group meeting type

operations.description: Get historical meetings for the specified group that started within the specified date/time range. This API call is only available to users with the admin role. This API call is restricted to groups with a maximum of 50 organizers. Remark: Meetings which are still ongoing at the time of the request are NOT contained in the result array.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] groups historical meetings [PARAMS] authorization date end group key start [SCHEMA] by group historical meeting type

operations.description: DEPRECATED: Please use the new API calls 'Get historical meetings by group' and 'Get upcoming meetings by group'. Get meetings for a specified group. Additional filters can be used to view only meetings within a specified date range. This API call is only available to users with the admin role.
operations.summary: DEPRECATED: Get historical meetings by group
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] groups meetings [PARAMS] authorization date end group history key start [SCHEMA] by group history meeting type

operations.description: Returns all the organizers within a specific group. This API call is only available to users with the admin role.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] groups organizers [PARAMS] authorization group key [SCHEMA] by group organizer product

operations.description: Get upcoming meetings for a specified group. This API call is only available to users with the admin role. This API call can be used only for groups with maximum 50 organizers.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] groups upcoming meetings [PARAMS] authorization group key [SCHEMA] by group meeting status type upcoming

operations.description: Get historical meetings for the currently authenticated organizer that started within the specified date/time range. Remark: Meetings which are still ongoing at the time of the request are NOT contained in the result array.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] historical meetings [PARAMS] authorization date end start [SCHEMA] historical meeting type

operations.description: DEPRECATED: Please use the new API calls 'Get historical meetings' and 'Get upcoming meetings'.  Gets historical meetings for the current authenticated organizer. Requires date range for filtering results to only meetings within specified dates. History searches will contain the parameter 'meetingInstanceKey' which is used in conjunction with the call 'Get Attendees by Meeting' to get attendee information for a past meeting.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] meetings [PARAMS] authorization date end history start [SCHEMA] history meeting type

operations.description: Returns the meeting details for the specified meeting.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] meetings [PARAMS] authorization id meeting [SCHEMA] by id meeting status type

operations.description: List all attendees for specified meetingId of historical meeting. The historical meetings can be fetched using 'Get historical meetings', 'Get historical meetings by organizer', and 'Get historical meetings by group'. For users with the admin role this call returns attendees for any meeting. For any other user the call will return attendees for meetings on which the user is a valid organizer.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] meetings attendees [PARAMS] authorization id meeting [SCHEMA] attendee by meeting type

operations.description: Returns a host URL that can be used to start a meeting. When this URL is opened in a web browser, the GoToMeeting client will be downloaded and launched and the meeting will start. The end user is not required to login to a client.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] meetings start [PARAMS] authorization id meeting [SCHEMA] start url

operations.description: Gets the individual organizer specified by the organizer's email address. If an email address is not specified, all organizers are returned. This API call is only available to users with the admin role.
operations.summary: Get organizer by email / Get all organizers
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] organizers [PARAMS] authorization email [SCHEMA] organizer product

operations.description: Returns the individual organizer specified by the key. This API call is only available to users with the admin role. Non-admin users can only make this call for their own organizerKey.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] organizers [PARAMS] authorization key organizer [SCHEMA] organizer product

operations.description: Lists all attendees for all meetings within a specified date range for a specified organizer. This API call is only available to users with the admin role.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] organizers attendees [PARAMS] authorization date end key organizer start [SCHEMA] attendee by meeting organizer type

operations.description: Get historical meetings for the specified organizer that started within the specified date/time range. Remark: Meetings which are still ongoing at the time of the request are NOT contained in the result array.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] organizers historical meetings [PARAMS] authorization date end key organizer start [SCHEMA] historical meeting type

operations.description: DEPRECATED: Please use the new API calls 'Get historical meetings by organizer' and 'Get upcoming meetings by organizer'. Gets future (scheduled) or past (history) meetings for a specified organizer. Include 'history=true' and the past start and end dates in the URL to retrieve past meetings. Enter 'scheduled=true' (without dates) to get scheduled meetings.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] organizers meetings [PARAMS] authorization date end history key organizer scheduled start [SCHEMA] by meeting organizer status type

operations.description: Get upcoming meetings for a specified organizer. This API call is only available to users with the admin role.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] organizers upcoming meetings [PARAMS] authorization key organizer [SCHEMA] meeting status type upcoming

operations.description: Gets upcoming meetings for the current authenticated organizer.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] upcoming meetings [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] meeting status type upcoming

operations.description: Creates a new organizer and sends an email to the email address defined in request. This API call is only available to users with the admin role. You may also pass 'G2W' or 'G2T' or 'OPENVOICE' as productType variables, creating organizers for those products. A G2W or G2T organizer will also have access to G2M.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] groups organizers [PARAMS] authorization group key [SCHEMA] organizer product req short

operations.description: Create a new meeting based on the parameters specified.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] meetings [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] create created meeting req type

operations.description: Creates a new organizer and sends an email to the email address defined in the request. This API call is only available to users with the admin role. You may also pass 'G2W' or 'G2T' or 'OPENVOICE' as productType variables, creating organizers for those products. A G2W or G2T organizer will also have access to G2M.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] organizers [PARAMS] authorization [SCHEMA] organizer product req short

operations.description: Updates an existing meeting specified by meetingId.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] meetings [PARAMS] authorization id meeting [SCHEMA] meeting req type update

operations.description: Updates the products of the specified organizer. To add a product (G2M, G2W, G2T, OPENVOICE) for the organizer, the call must be sent once for each product you want to add. To remove all products for the organizer, set status to 'suspended'. The call is limited to users with the admin role.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME]  [PATH] organizers [PARAMS] authorization key organizer [SCHEMA] organizer product status
